captions.detailed: A large, matte-black family air fryer featuring a squared body with a sloped upper control panel. The control interface includes a central cylindrical selector knob and four separate rectangular preset buttons arranged below it. Below the panel, a wide pull-out drawer with an integrated front handle houses a hollow basket drawer, accented by a small red release latch button. The drawer slides horizontally out of the main housing, the selector knob rotates, the preset buttons can be pressed, and the red latch button depresses along its axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a large family air fryer with a squared body and a sloped control panel. It must include a functional pull-out drawer with an open internal basket, a rotating central selector knob, four pressable preset buttons, and a red prismatic latch button on the front handle.
captions.factory: The base housing is constructed by subtracting a hollow inner cavity from a main box and attaching a sloped control panel at the top front. The drawer is constructed as a separate part with an open hollow basket volume and an attached handle block. The selector knob is formed as a cylinder rotated relative to the sloped panel, while the four preset buttons are small boxes positioned along its bottom edge. A small red box is defined on top of the handle to serve as the prismatic latch button. Prismatic joints are defined for the drawer slide and latch button, while a continuous joint is defined for the selector knob.
